name: StructuredRAG
description: StructuredRAG is a benchmark consisting of six tasks designed to assess Large Language Models' ability to generate structured JSON outputs following response format instructions. It evaluates models on success rates across tasks involving lists and composite object outputs, highlighting challenges in reliability and consistency of structured output generation.
reputation: A recent benchmark for structured JSON generation that is gaining attention in structured-output reliability research but is not yet a standard benchmark.
notes: Includes evaluation of two prompting strategies; success rates vary widely across tasks and models.
